description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/banking-credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring" name="Credit scoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest"
                      name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Bank_SendRequest"
                      targetRef="Agency_Start"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotification"
                      name="Delay notification"
                      sourceRef="Agency_SendDelay"
                      targetRef="Bank_CatchDelay"
                      messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult"
                      name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Agency_SendImmediateResult"
                      targetRef="Bank_CatchImmediateResult"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result"
                      name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Agency_SendLevel2Result"
                      targetRef="Bank_CatchLevel2Result"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Banking system credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Bank">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesClerk" name="Sales clerk">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_RequestScoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_SendRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_WaitForAgencyResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_CatchImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_CatchDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_DisplayDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_CatchLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_MergeResults</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_DisplayResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Bank_End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Bank_Start" name="Scoring requested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Bank_RequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring via frontend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Bank_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Bank_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Bank_CatchImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Bank_ImmediateResultMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Bank_CatchDelay" name="Receive delay notification">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Bank_DelayMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Bank_DisplayDelay" name="Display message to check again later"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Bank_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Bank_Level2ResultMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Bank_MergeResults" name="Merge scoring result paths"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Bank_DisplayResult" name="Display scoring result at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Bank_End" name="Result displayed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_1" sourceRef="Bank_Start" targetRef="Bank_RequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_2" sourceRef="Bank_RequestScoring" targetRef="Bank_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_3" sourceRef="Bank_SendRequest" targetRef="Bank_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_4" sourceRef="Bank_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Bank_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_5" sourceRef="Bank_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Bank_CatchDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_6" sourceRef="Bank_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Bank_MergeResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_7" sourceRef="Bank_CatchDelay" targetRef="Bank_DisplayDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_8" sourceRef="Bank_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Bank_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_9" sourceRef="Bank_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Bank_MergeResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_10" sourceRef="Bank_MergeResults" targetRef="Bank_DisplayResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_11" sourceRef="Bank_DisplayResult" targetRef="Bank_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Agency">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Agency" name="Agency">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_Level1Scoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_ResultImmediate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_SendImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_SendDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_Level2Scoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_SendLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_EndImmediate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Agency_EndLevel2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Agency_Start" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Agency_ScoringRequestMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Agency_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Agency_ResultImmediate" name="Is the result determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Agency_SendImmediateResult" name="Send scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Agency_SendDelay" name="Send delay notification" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Agency_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Agency_SendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Agency_EndImmediate" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Agency_EndLevel2" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Agency_Flow_1" sourceRef="Agency_Start" targetRef="Agency_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Agency_Flow_2" sourceRef="Agency_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Agency_ResultImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Agency_Flow_3" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Agency_ResultImmediate" targetRef="Agency_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">immediateResultAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Agency_Flow_4" name="Result takes longer" sourceRef="Agency_ResultImmediate" targetRef="Agency_SendDelay">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not immediateResultAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Agency_Flow_5" sourceRef="Agency_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Agency_EndImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Agency_Flow_6" sourceRef="Agency_SendDelay" targetRef="Agency_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Agency_Flow_7" sourceRef="Agency_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Agency_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Agency_Flow_8" sourceRef="Agency_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Agency_EndLevel2"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
